ComStock assumes four categories of lighting: General (overhead lighting), Task (lights focused on specific areas), Supplemental (additional lighting), and Wall Wash (illuminates vertical surface). The lighting technologies used in each category across the ComStock lighting generations are listed in Table 6. Generations 4–8 represent varying efficacy levels of LEDs, with Generation 4 being the first LED technology to market and Generation 8 being the estimated technology level in 2035. ComStock currently only includes Generations 1 through 5 in its model, though Generations 6 through 8 could be added in the future. 7 This report is available at no cost from NREL at www.nrel.gov/publications.
